name: Sahel insurgency
summary: Armed group kills 13 National Guard members at Sanam in western Niger; insurgency sustained, no capital blockaded
state: Niger's defence ministry said on state television on 26 Nov that an armed group killed 13 National Guard members and injured 20 in an attack at Sanam in the Tillabéri region (AP). Groups linked to al-Qaeda and Islamic State keep fighting state forces across Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, and ACLED tracks continuing economic warfare by jihadist groups. No blockade or fall of a capital or major city, and no mass-casualty attack in a coastal state, was found as of 27 Nov, so Watch holds.
for_you: The FCDO advises against all or all but essential travel to most of Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger. Violence keeps displacing rural communities and disrupting markets, roads and aid deliveries across the central Sahel.
rubric_hit: Watch: sustained insurgency — 13 soldiers killed at Sanam, Niger, announced 26 Nov; no capital blockade

sources.title: ABC News (AP) — Armed group kills 13 soldiers in western Niger attack, defense ministry says

why: Jihadist groups control growing territory across Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, driving displacement and coastal-state spillover.
drivers: JNIM/IS-Sahel offensives, juntas, Russian forces, blockades, coastal-state attacks.
